title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | PASS-OFF ENGLISH | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ PASSOFF- 105 ]

blocks.text: My favorite time is Friday night because it is the start of the weekend. It is the end of normal schedule of school and academies.
I can reflect on things that did not go well and hopefully plan a better
new week. Before I do this, I start thinking about the fun things that
I have planned for the upcoming weekend 듣습니다.
